name: Abdul
title: Full-Stack Developer
heroTagline: Building scalable full-stack applications with modern cloud architecture.
bio: I develop production-ready web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS. My focus is scalable architecture, real-time systems, and high-performance user experiences.
aboutBio:
I'm a Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience across fintech, AI, e-commerce, and manufacturing — from idea to deployed production systems.

Currently at Sterlings Tech, I build Amana Pay (digital wallet & core-banking platform with payment-switch integrations) and Scribe (AI study platform with LLM pipelines, collaborative workspaces, and Stripe billing). Previously at Wimetrix, I delivered a real-time garment manufacturing KPI dashboard; at DAppster, an AI trading analysis tool powered by Google Gemini.

My personal portfolio includes four deployed full-stack projects — multi-tenant CRM, Task Studio with BullMQ & Socket.IO, and Black Pearl e-commerce (store + seller portal) — demonstrating end-to-end ownership of architecture, backend APIs, frontend UX, and cloud deployment.

I work comfortably across React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, Express, Fastify, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and AI integrations — with a focus on clean APIs, RBAC, real-time features, and systems that scale.
